title: Audited rule policy: detectors stay, enforcement goes
summary: This change introduces a compiled enforcement policy (`lints/policy.rs`) that turns off a set of audited writing and skill rules by default, while keeping their detectors and fixture contracts alive for evaluation. Consumers — the stop hook, `lint writing`, `lint skill`, and `verify` — now merge these off-levels into the config levels they apply, so a repository's own `osf.toml` can no longer re-enable a disabled rule or disable a retained one. Alongside the policy, the diff fixes several detectors: the em-dash rule narrows to U+2014 only, `weasel-attribution` accepts a labelled HTTP(S) link in the same sentence, `reference-without-link` is dropped in commit context, generated merge subjects are exempted from `bare-reference`, the co-author trailer match becomes case-insensitive, and the regex-based script pin check is replaced by a token-level `script_pins` module with an explicit coverage statement. `parenthetical` and `skill-reads-as-manual` are removed outright.
